tip.en: HR rockets from 72 to 82 bpm in under 10 seconds as you accelerate hard off the mark — a steeper cardiac ramp than your recent easier starts. Flat ground in Auckland means this spike is entirely effort-driven, not grade-assisted.
tip.zh: 从起跑到此处不足10秒，心率从72飙升至82次/分，起步冲劲明显比近期几次跑步更猛。奥克兰路面平坦，说明这次心率攀升完全来自主动发力，而非地形助力。

title.en: Cardiac Ceiling at 135 — Flat Road, Elevated Cost
title.zh: 心率触顶135——平路上的高代谢代价

tip.en: You've been holding 135 bpm for over a minute on pancake-flat terrain around the 0.7–0.8 km mark — that's close to your recent Shanghai effort-pace HR on actual uphills. For a declared easy city trot, this zone is a flag worth noting.
tip.zh: 在0.7–0.8公里的完全平坦路段，你已持续维持135次/分超过一分钟——这接近你在上海上坡冲坡时的心率水平。若定位为轻松城市慢跑，这个心率区间值得留意。

tip.en: HR plunges from 133 to 120 in 15 seconds as pace collapses to walk/null around km 1.3 — a pedestrian crossing or a deliberate breather. Notably the first of several breaks that redefine this as an interrupted run rather than a continuous effort.
tip.zh: 心率在15秒内从133骤降至120，配速跌至步行或归零，位于约1.3公里处——可能是等红灯或主动放松。这是全程多次中断中的第一次，使这次跑步性质上更接近间歇运动而非持续有氧。

title.en: Extended Rest Zone — HR Bottoms at 105
title.zh: 长时停顿区——心率低谷至105

tip.en: From roughly km 2.1 to 2.9 you spend over 400 seconds at walking pace or stopped, HR sliding from 129 all the way down to 87. This 7-minute interruption mid-run means your cardiovascular stimulus was fragmented — worth tracking whether this is a navigation choice or fatigue signal.
tip.zh: 从约2.1公里到2.9公里，你花费超过400秒步行或停止，心率从129一路滑落至87。这次7分钟的跑步中断意味着心血管刺激被切断——建议关注这究竟是路线选择还是疲劳信号。

title.en: Clean Re-Build After the Long Pause
title.zh: 长时停顿后的干净重建

tip.en: After the extended rest zone you reconstruct smoothly: HR climbs from 88 to 96 over 300m at km 3.2, pace tightening to 5:16 without spiking. This kind of controlled re-entry is better cardiac hygiene than surging hard after a stop.
tip.zh: 经过长时停顿后，你的重新起步非常平稳：在3.2公里处300米内心率从88升至96，配速收紧至5:16但没有冲刺。这种受控的重新投入比停止后猛冲更有利于心脏负荷管理。

title.en: Max HR 138 — Reached at a Crawl
title.zh: 最高心率138——在近乎停步时触顶

tip.en: Your session peak of 138 bpm arrives here at km 3.5 as pace slows to 17:00 min/km — almost a standstill. The pattern suggests HR peaked through accumulated drift and stop-start stress, not a hard effort. Compare to recent max HRs of 153–175: today's ceiling is conspicuously low, consistent with a recovery day.
tip.zh: 全程心率峰值138次/分出现在3.5公里处，此时配速已慢至17:00/公里——几乎停步。这种模式表明心率峰值来自累积漂移和走走停停的压力，而非主动冲刺。对比近期153–175的最高心率，今天的上限明显偏低，符合恢复日的特征。

title.zh: 奥克兰唯一一段真正上坡

tip.en: A sharp 4.3% ramp at km 4.6 is the steepest grade of the whole run — yet HR only sits at 114 and pace is a lively 4:04, your fastest readable split. After weeks of 130m+ elevation routes, this tiny bump barely registers physiologically, but it's a good reminder of how flat Auckland is by comparison.
tip.zh: 4.6公里处出现全程最陡的4.3%坡度——然而心率仅114次/分，配速达到4:04，是全程可读最快配速。经历连续数周超过130米爬升的路线后，这段小坡在生理上几乎毫无压力，但也恰好说明奥克兰地形相比之下有多平坦。
